ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query is a creative/instruction-following task (write a clean, usable math problem from a given hypothesis). Dunlin outperforms Lapwing on the relevant evals — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4) — which matters given the user's explicit demand for higher quality than prior attempts. Cost, latency, and context window are identical, and the content is benign, so Lapwing's moderation-oriented tuning offers no advantage. Dunlin is simply the stronger general-purpose model for this request.
